subject: maths
question: By selling 55 meters of cloth, one gains the selling price of 11 meters. Find the gain percent.
solution: Given: By selling 55 meters of cloth, one gains the selling price of 11 meters. Concept used: SP = CP + profit Profit percentage = (Profit / CP) × 100
